title: Malicious code in testpackage83 (npm)
description: The npm package 'testpackage83' version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that downloads and executes an untrusted binary from an unverified HTTP source during installation and runtime. This binary is fetched from a suspicious IPv4 address and masquerades as a patched Chromium executable. The package executes this binary via puppeteer-core, potentially allowing arbitrary code execution on the user's machine.
